interpretation.what_this_proves: the new OpenVSP 3.55.0 + VSPAERO 7.2.2 toolchain can prepare the exact inputs a solver run would need, with Sref/cref/bref/CG/Mach/AoA frozen to the D-12D-002 contract values, and the setup content is reproducible from the committed scripts
interpretation.what_this_does_not_prove: nothing about VSPAERO 7.2.2 supersonic accuracy, convergence, or panel/wake behaviour at Mach 2.02; no lift/drag/moment value was produced; no physical gate may change
interpretation.thick_vs_thin: the thick-surface mesh (GeomSet=0) is 1082 nodes / 1088 elements and the thin-surface mesh (ThinGeomSet=0) is 527 nodes / 480 elements for the same wing; Round-2 must state which set is used and never mix them

caveats: setup355b/_model was overwritten because OpenVSP derives output file names from the model export path; setup355c re-ran each variant in its own directory (lesson LD-004)
VSPAEROMgr.h downloaded from the release tree is a 14-byte placeholder; the .cpp files are the authority
the OpenVSP Python API returns an empty result id for VSPAEROSweep even on success; results must be captured via file outputs (consistent with LD-002)
generated_utc_meaning: package-assembly timestamp written when this JSON was assembled; the setup files were written earlier (mtimes 2026-11-02T02:08Z). Not an event timestamp (A1 task-43 F3).

package_copy_note.issue: the setup file as stored by OpenVSP is CRLF (930 B, 42 lines, sha256 c862aa220bc6f3a9d057b2fbe99c4ed340591a14ad88f455d3d1b0ddbe7c1804); git normalises committed text to canonical LF (888 B, 42 lines, sha256 360618f4b406fa72ed4bd7676892aad268d5ce19ee196deee2d7b54136e43d3c) (A5 F-02)
package_copy_note.note: both forms are the same logical file; data_manifest.json hashes text as canonical LF and binary files as raw bytes

defaults_not_frozen_contract.issue: the generated .vspaero currently carries VSPAERO defaults for three quantities, not the frozen task_fixed_cruise contract values (A1 task-43 F2). This is a Round-2 readiness gap, not a Round-1 physical claim.
defaults_not_frozen_contract.action_required: any Round-2 LF case generator must inject and assert these three contract values before requesting an owner-approved solver start; the files in this package must not be fed to a solver as-is
